education.detail: Deep Learning for Computer Vision · cum laude
Information and Communications Engineering · cum laude

experience.description: Work on perception, reconstruction, and foundation models for autonomous vehicles in the Spatial Intelligence Lab (SIL), contributing to internal products and research publications. Supervise research interns.

Researched multimodal 2D, 3D, and 4D perception and reconstruction across research and product projects. Co-supervised Complete Anything in LiDAR, from implementation and research to paper writing, and contributed to efficient multi-camera tokenization for autonomous driving.

Investigated multimodal perception and knowledge transfer across dense and sparse recognition tasks in the Vision Representation Learning team, supervised by Riccardo Volpi and Yannis Kalantidis. Received the NAVER LABS Europe Intern Day Distinguished Award for the multitask learning project.
Developed 3D perception methods that remain robust across different domains and environments, under the supervision of Laura Leal-Taixé and Aljoša Ošep.

Studied 3D point-cloud perception under distribution shifts and limited supervision, including self-supervised representation learning and novel-class discovery. Completed a PhD in Deep Learning for Computer Vision, cum laude, advised by Elisa Ricci, Nicu Sebe, and Fabio Galasso.
